note: Pinned SEO decisions, checked against PRODUCTION on every deploy (npm run deploy:verify -> seo:live, scripts/lib/live-seo-audit.mjs). Each entry is a decision Matt made; the live site must keep it. Adding an entry is free. Changing or removing one needs an `SEO-decision: <who, when, why>` commit trailer (scripts/check-seo-decisions.mjs, commit-msg hook), because a failing check here means the SITE regressed, not that the entry is wrong. expect: status (HTTP), location (redirect target path), index (robots), canonical ('self' or a path), title / h1 (regex), html (regexes the served HTML must contain).

Undo SITE-33's out-of-area noindex: Search Console showed it cost ~36% of the impression drop since Sep 12 (~2,500 impressions, ~30 clicks a week). Out-of-area listings are index, follow with a self canonical, in /sitemaps/listings.xml, and keep the honesty block. Sample: an Active Medford listing on the feed since 2020.

IndexNow tells Bing, and the answer engines that search through it (ChatGPT search, Copilot), about changed pages only: listings the MLS delta sync inserted or whose status, price or photos changed, and a blog post when it is published or updated. Production only (VERCEL_ENV). Never submit unchanged URLs in bulk. The key is public by protocol (lib/seo/indexnow.ts); this file at the site root proves it, and if it stops serving the key every submission fails with 403.
Listing photos in the image sitemap and listing video tours in a video sitemap, both reached from the one sitemap index Google is given.

Every listing photo (up to 30 per listing, the 1600x1200 render the page loads) ships in /sitemaps/listing-photos/{1..24}.xml so Google Images ties each MLS photograph to its listing page. listings.xml keeps the lead photo.
ODS: listing photos and videos are the listing broker's; we hotlink the MLS CDN (Spark) and embed videos from their host, never a re-hosted copy, until a license says otherwise.
Listing video tours for Google video search: only YouTube or Vimeo players with a real MLS date, never a date invented and never a file of ours. 418 listings on 2026-10-14.
A community with an area guide carries the same complete VideoObject as /cities/bend. Juniper Preserve's guide is tagged with its durable key 'pronghorn' and was missed until 2026-10-14.
